Manisha set apart with her friends to explore the countryside.
questions.solution: Set apart' should be replaced with 'set out' because the sentence refers to "exploring the countryside," which implies starting a journey or embarking on an adventure. questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Stories are how we make ______________________ of our lives and of the world.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Stories are how we make ______________________ of our lives and of the world.
questions.solution: 'Sense' will be used because it means the ability to understand or derive meaning from something. The sentence implies that stories help us make sense of our lives and the world, making 'sense' the correct choice. 'Sensitivity' means being sensitive or having the ability to perceive, which doesn't fit here. 'Innate' means inborn or natural, which is irrelevant in this context. 'Sagacious' means wise or discerning, but it is not suitable for this sentence.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Please turn off the lights _________ leaving the house
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Please turn off the lights _________ leaving the house
questions.solution: 'Before' is the correct choice because it means "prior to." The sentence specifies "leaving the house," indicating that the action of turning off the lights should occur before leaving, making 'before' the most appropriate option. 'Amid' means "in the midst of," which does not fit the context here. 'Between' refers to "in the middle of two things," but it does not align with the time-related context of the sentence. 'During' means "at the time of," which changes the intended meaning of the sentence and is therefore inappropriate.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. Wolves’ teeth are larger and strong than dog’s teeth.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Wolves’ teeth are larger and strong than dog’s teeth.
questions.solution: जैसे: Wolves’ teeth are larger and stronger than dog’s teeth. "strong" will be replaced with "stronger" because the sentence shows a comparison. When two entities are compared, the comparative degree of the adjective is used. Here, "larger" and "than" already indicate a comparison, so "stronger" is the correct choice. For example: Wolves’ teeth are larger and stronger than dog’s teeth.

questions.question: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error . Parts of northern France were also (A) / put in drought alert, with (B) / water supplies to businesses, (C) / farmers and ordinary residents restricted. (D)
questions.questionHtml:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Parts of northern France were also (A) / put in drought alert, with (B) / water supplies to businesses, (C) / farmers and ordinary residents restricted. (D)

options.text: (A) Parts of northern France were also
options.html: (A) Parts of northern France were also
(B) put in drought alert, with
(C) water supplies to businesses,
(D) farmers and ordinary residents restricted.

questions.solution:
The correct preposition to use with "alert" in this context is "on", not "in."
We say "put on alert" or "placed on drought alert" to indicate that a warning or watch has been issued for a particular condition.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. That day and the cash availability, bread and butter were budgeted B. In the late 1980s and early 1990s when I was growing up, there were mom-and-pop stores for daily essential shopping C. We did not go to the mall and buy 500 gm of butter; instead, depending on how many people were at our house D. I remember buying half a pack of bread and 25 gm of butter, which was a quarter piece of a 100-gm pack, from our neighbourhood shop
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. That day and the cash availability, bread and butter were budgeted

B. In the late 1980s and early 1990s when I was growing up, there were mom-and-pop stores for daily essential shopping

C. We did not go to the mall and buy 500 gm of butter; instead, depending on how many people were at our house

D. I remember buying half a pack of bread and 25 gm of butter, which was a quarter piece of a 100-gm pack, from our neighbourhood shop
questions.solution: B: B provides a contextual introduction about the time frame and sets the stage for the rest of the story. It provides background about the mom-and-pop stores which were prevalent during the narrator's childhood. B provides the time frame "late 1980s and early 1990s."
